definition: Each sampled skill's description is rewritten to lead with the action, carry explicit verbatim trigger phrases, and end with a SKIP clause fencing off the look-alike requests in the frozen near-miss and trivial-edit prompts. Nothing else in any file changes. The result is attributed to this bundle as a whole, never to length or to the SKIP clause independently.

descriptions.plan-before-code: Work out the approach before writing code: explore the codebase, size the task, and produce an implementation design. Use this whenever the user says plan this, work out the approach, map out how we would, think before coding, design this first, or asks for a change spanning several modules or layers. SKIP: explaining what existing code does, running tests or builds, answering a factual question about the repository, and any single-file mechanical edit such as changing a constant or fixing a typo.
descriptions.html-output-conventions: Choose the smallest representation that answers the request, and produce an HTML artifact when one is genuinely warranted, from four self-contained templates. Use this whenever the user asks for an interactive page, a dashboard, a shareable artifact, a navigable report, a many-way comparison with controls, or anything they will open rather than read inline. SKIP: a short factual answer, a handful of values that read faster as an inline table, a one-sentence summary, and any mechanical text edit such as renaming a heading or adding a newline.
descriptions.skill-description-authoring: Rewrite a skill description so the agent selects it when it should and leaves it alone when it should not. Use this whenever the user says this skill never triggers, it fires on everything, rewrite the description, tighten the triggers, add a SKIP clause, or reports over- or under-selection of a skill. SKIP: counting or listing catalog contents, editing frontmatter fields other than description such as author or version, capitalisation and other mechanical text fixes, and any request naming a skill that does not exist, which is declared as missing rather than substituted.
descriptions.context-engineering: Shape what a session loads, carries and drops so the work fits the context budget. Use this whenever the user says running out of context, what should be loaded, structure the context, design what each phase receives, trim the working set, or describes a long or multi-phase job losing earlier detail. SKIP: reporting a model's token limit, deleting or editing files on disk, and any single small edit such as adding one bullet or correcting a spelling, which is made directly.

unchanged: Every other byte of every sampled skill, and every other file in the corpus, is identical to variant A.
why_skip_clauses_matter: The frozen near-miss and trivial-edit prompts are the look-alikes each SKIP clause fences off. If variant B reduces irrelevant selection, that is the mechanism the acceptance criteria will detect; if it also loses a positive selection, criterion 1 fails and B is not promoted.
